channel.title: mint - news
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: Trump Says US Looking at Whether Binance Hack Was By North Korea
item.description: President Donald Trump said the US was looking into whether North Korean hackers were behind a $6.3 billion heist targeting Binance that has rattled the cryptocurrency world.

item.title: Kochi airport iPhone customs row explained: Why was an NRI passenger asked to pay nearly ₹30,000?
item.description: An NRI passenger's refusal to pay nearly ₹30,000 in customs duty on a new iPhone brought from Dubai has triggered a police case and raised questions about India's baggage rules for personal electronic devices.

item.title: DOJ Seeks Grand Jury Indictment of Comey in Defense Secrets Case
item.description: The Justice Department is actively working to secure a grand jury indictment against former FBI Director James Comey for allegedly directing the sharing of secret national defense information, a federal prosecutor said in court Friday.

item.title: Who was KM Tahsif Souri? Dismissed by Bangladesh Air Force post filming Sheikh Hasina's escape, mysteriously found dead
item.description: Former Bangladesh Air Force officer KM Tahsif Souri, 28, was found dead in Dhaka's Turag River days after being reported missing. His cousin alleges he was murdered over footage of Sheikh Hasina fleeing Bangladesh, but police have not established a motive or link to the video.

item.title: Who is Jahnvi Singh? IIM Calcutta graduate left McKinsey to join Google, here's why, she explains difference
item.description: A content creator went viral after revealing that she left McKinsey and joined Google, despite the former being her dream job. She talked about the differences in two job profiles, travel, benefits and work-life balance.

item.title: Trump Accounts: How a ‘moment becomes a movement’ — why Michael Dell hailed growing support as he reveals donors
item.description: Michael Dell says donations to Trump Accounts are growing into a national movement. Contributions include SpaceX executive Gwynne Shotwell and investor Ray Dalio, while Dell and his wife have pledged $6.25 billion for children.&nbsp;

item.title: Census 2027: Self-enumeration to begin on January 10, door-to-door population count from January 25
item.description: The Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA) on Friday notified the schedule for the second phase of Census 2027, with the population enumeration exercise to be conducted from January 25 to February 28, 2027, followed by a revisional round from March 1 to 5.

item.title: MCA says its role in NCLT appointments is only administrative after Supreme Court remarks
item.description: The NCLT independently handles the appointment and management of its officers and staff, including deputy registrars, court officers, stenographers, office assistants and multi-tasking staff, the ministry said in a statement.

item.title: India's diesel exports hit 13-month high amid Iran war: How refiners are cashing in on supply disruptions
item.description: India’s diesel exports hit a 13-month high in October, rising 19.6% month-on-month as refiners capitalised on global supply disruptions linked to the Iran war and Russia-Ukraine conflict. Reliance Industries accounted for nearly 78% of exports amid strong overseas demand and elevated margins.

item.title: Yogi Adityanath's UP govt tightens job rules after GenZ protests: Who can be barred from government jobs?
item.description: The Yogi Adityanath government has revised character verification rules for UP government jobs, barring candidates linked to violent organisations and those facing specified criminal charges.&nbsp;

item.title: Govt names 1993-batch IAS officer Poundrik as heavy industries secretary
item.description: Poundrik's appointment comes at a time when crucial tasks for the heavy industries ministry would be to ensure smooth continuation of key electric mobility schemes such as the ₹25,938-crore production-linked incentive scheme for automobiles and auto parts and the ₹11,900-crore PM E-Drive scheme.

item.title: Who are Imaan Mazari and Hadi Ali Chattha? Here's why Pakistan jailed the human rights lawyer couple for 10 years
item.description: Pakistani human rights lawyer Imaan Mazari and her husband, Hadi Ali Chattha, have been sentenced to 10 years in prison in a case involving the removal of road barriers during an England cricket team's visit. Here is the case and the controversy.

item.title: DRI cracks down on Myanmar-linked drug network, seizes 50 kg meth in Northeast, arrests four
item.description: The seizures were made on 29 and 30 October, following specific intelligence inputs about the transportation of multiple consignments of narcotics from Zokhawthar towards Aizawl and Silchar, the finance ministry said in a statement on Friday.

item.title: India bets on ‘sealed rooms’ to train AI on sensitive data without exposing it
item.description: Under Depa, data remains with its owner, while a “sealed room”, which is a secure computing environment, runs only what an authorised digital contract permits. No one can access the data inside, not even the company operating the system, according to the launch presentation.

item.title: Who is former Wing Commander Cecil Barretto? IAF celebrates 104th birthday of veteran who served in WWII, Kashmir War
item.description: The Indian Air Force celebrated the 104th birthday of Wing Commander Cecil Barretto (Retd), a World War II veteran and one of the founding officers of its Dental Branch, who also served during the 1947–48 India-Pakistan War.

item.title: Madras High Court issues notice on plea to investigate CJP's Saurav Das, block his X and Instagram accounts
item.description: A businessman has approached the Madras High Court seeking an investigation into the background, identity documents and alleged funding of Yogesh Sharma, also known as Saurav Das, the National Co-Convenor of the Cockroach Janata Party.&nbsp;

item.title: Sourav Ganguly vs Doosra: Why the former India captain approached Delhi HC over his portrayal in the film | Explained
item.description: Sourav Ganguly has approached the Delhi High Court alleging that Doosra exploits his identity and cricketing legacy without consent. The court has asked him to identify specific objectionable scenes before considering interim relief.

item.title: Fiscal deficit rises to ₹7.14 trillion or 42.1% of FY27 target in first six months
item.description: The widening gap assumes significance as the government has cut its FY27 market borrowing by nearly ₹1.2 trillion

item.title: Government’s paddy procurement hit by weather woes, storage constraints
item.description: Between 1 and 28 October, government agencies, including the Food Corporation of India (FCI) and state agencies procuring on its behalf, bought 13 million tonnes of paddy, down from 16.9 million tonnes a year earlier, the people cited earlier said on condition of anonymity.

item.title: Future Group's Biyani brothers face lenders' ₹800 crore recovery push
item.description: Catalyst Trusteeship and Phoenix ARC have approached the court over unpaid loans to two Future Group companies.

item.title: All due processes followed in IDBI Bank's strategic restructuring: Nirmala Sitharaman
item.description: Union finance minister Nirmala Sitharaman's comments come in response to senior Congress leader Rahul Gandhi’s allegations that bids for IDBI Bank were first seen, and then the sale price was fixed.

item.title: Badrinath helicopter crash: Six on board, including pilot, dies, bodies found | What we know
item.description: Badrinath helicopter crash: A helicopter was on its way from Badrinath Dham in Chamoli to Dehradun when it went missing, according to officials. Six people were on board, including passengers from Bengaluru whose bodies have been found later.

item.title: Virat Kohli for a cracker-free Diwali? Supreme Court suggests celebrity-led campaign to curb pollution
item.description: The SC has suggested approaching Virat Kohli and other celebrated cricketers to lead a public awareness campaign for a cracker-free Diwali. The court's remarks came as it questioned the effectiveness of repeated firecracker restrictions.

item.title: Game of Thrones star Nikolaj Coster-Waldau spends night in Kyiv metro shelter amid Russian air raid threats | Pics
item.description: Game of Thrones actor Nikolaj Coster-Waldau spent a night in a Kyiv metro station amid Russian air raid threats. The UNDP Goodwill Ambassador shared his experience and called for continued support for Ukrainian civilians living through the war.

item.title: NCLAT scraps insolvency proceedings against Polycab over ₹2.78 crore claim
item.description: The dispute relates to the supply of aluminium ingots by Asier Metals. The supplier had approached the NCLT under Section 9 of the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code (IBC), claiming that Polycab had failed to clear its dues.

item.title: INDIA bloc postpones ‘public impeachment’ of CEC Gyanesh Kumar due to rain; to hold meeting on Saturday
item.description: The INDIA bloc has postponed its proposed symbolic “public impeachment” of CEC Gyanesh Kumar to October 31 because of rain in Delhi. The event, part of its campaign over alleged “vote chori” and the SIR exercise, will be followed by a rally at Ramlila Maidan on November 1.

item.title: This Bihar Museum ranks 9th globally: Anand Mahindra calls it ‘game changer’; here's what CM Samrat Choudhary did next
item.description: The Patna landmark notably outranked global cultural heavyweights, including New York's Metropolitan Museum of Art (10th) and Paris's Louvre (31st).

item.title: Mint explainer: why India wants to make its own shipping containers
item.description: India plans to scale annual container capacity more than tenfold by FY40 through a ₹10,000-crore scheme. Here's why it matters for trade, manufacturing and supply-chain resilience.

item.title: From Rashtrapati Bhavan to runway: Former ADC Major Rishabh Singh Sambyal debuts as a fashion model
item.description: Sambyal has officially partnered with the popular homegrown clothing brand Bonkers Corner on a new youth-focused streetwear collection.

item.title: GSLV-F18/NVS-03 Mission launch today: Check time, how to watch LIVE | All about 2nd gen NavIC series; 20th GSLV flight
item.description: ISRO is set to launch the GSLV-F18 carrying NVS-03 on October 30 at 11:51 pm. Here is the launch schedule, live streaming information and everything to know about India's next-generation NavIC satellite.

item.title: Beyond the weekend: theatres rejoice as films crack the weekday test
item.description: Movies across languages are finally able to attract audiences to the big screen beyond the opening weekend. Theatres are rolling out offers to make weekday pricing more attractive.

item.title: Jamia students end agitation after varsity meets most demands: What Lyngdoh Committee recommendations say
item.description: Jamia Millia Islamia has set May 15, 2027, as the deadline to approve and implement its students’ union constitution, ending a protest over restoring the JMISU. Elections are planned within six weeks of the next academic session, under Lyngdoh Committee guidelines.

item.title: CBDT plans ₹5,000-crore land buy for offices and staff quarters in Delhi, Mumbai and Bengaluru
item.description: The direct tax authority is targeting prime plots, including a ₹2,000-crore MTNL site in Delhi, to curb rising rental costs and accommodate an expanding workforce across metros.

item.title: Crypto exchange Binance freezes assets after $6.3 billion security breach
item.description: Binance reported a security breach with an estimated $6.3 billion impact, potentially the largest crypto heist on record. About $3 billion has been located, while the exchange says it will cover losses.&nbsp;

item.title: Israel Election: Netanyahu cries foul as Likud falls short of majority; authorities reject voter fraud claims
item.description: Israel election results leave Netanyahu short of a majority as Likud alleges voter fraud by Arab parties. Police and election officials reject claims of widespread irregularities.
